ICS 75.080PCD 01New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThe Indian Standard (Part 183) which is identical with ISO 14935 : 2020 ‘Petroleum and related products - Determination of wick flame persistence of fire-resistant fluids’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Methods for Sampling and Test for Petroleum and Related Products of Synthetic or Biological Origin Including Lubricants, Greases, Speciality Products, Additives and Gaseous Fuels (excluding Bitumen) Sectional Committee and approval of the Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division Council.
